name: ListRow
title: ListRow
summary: A 56px row of icon or avatar, title, meta and an end slot, grouped as a divided list or inset card, plus the React `ListRow` audio row with progress and play.
whenToUse: Use for settings, menus, people, languages, downloads and links in app screens and account pages.
Use the React `ListRow` for audio Bible chapters and teachings: title, progress, duration and play.
Use `.cr-list.cr-list-div` (hairline between rows) on web pages; use `.cr-list-inset` (grouped cards with a group heading) in app screens and settings.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for data with several comparable columns; use Table. Do not use for marketing content with images; use Card.

anatomy.description: Leading slot (`.cr-lr-ic` icon tile or `.cr-av` avatar, optional) › text (`.cr-lr-t` title, `.cr-lr-m` meta) › end slot (`.cr-lr-end`: value, ›, ↗ or switch).

props.name: dark
props.description: Dark surface styling. Set `false` on light surfaces.

props.name: onPlay
props.description: Called when the play button is pressed.

props.name: playLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the play button. Override to translate.

props.name: icon
props.description: Shown in a 40dp round tile. Decorative.

props.name: title
props.description: Chapter or teaching name, one line.

props.name: dark
props.description: Dark surface styling. Set `false` on light surfaces. Defaults to the theme scheme.

props.name: onPlay
props.description: Called when the play button is pressed.

props.name: playLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the play button. Pass it translated.

variants.class: .cr-lr-end with a chevron; the row is an <a>
.cr-sw switch in the end slot; the whole row toggles
.cr-lr-two: meta wraps to two lines, then ellipsis
.cr-list-inset › .overline + .cr-inset-grp (divider inset past the icon; add .cr-lr-noic to rows with no icon)

variantNotes: States: default, hover (`--off-white`; `.cr-is-hover` for docs), focus (inset 2px Horizon Blue ring), disabled (`.cr-lr-off`, 45%).

states.documented: default, hover (`--off-white`; `.cr-is-hover` for docs), focus (inset 2px Horizon Blue ring), disabled (`.cr-lr-off`, 45%).
states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Rows are at least 56px tall with 20px side padding; the whole row is the tap target (well over 44px).
Icons in the end slot: › = drills into an app screen, ↗ = goes to another page, ⌄ = opens here. Never mix › and ↗ in one group without reason.
A row with › or ↗ is one `<a>`; never nest another link or button inside it.
A row with a switch toggles from anywhere on the row; the switch is the only control.
The switch uses Horizon Blue (`--horizon-blue`) when on; keep primary buttons out of list groups.
Use `--gradient-violet` avatars and `--blue-tint` icon tiles; keep one leading style per group.
Keep titles to one line. Only `.cr-lr-two` rows may wrap their meta.
The React audio row draws its progress in solid Horizon Blue as built. When you build an audio row in HTML, use AccentBar (`.cr-accentbar`, gradient) for the progress line instead.

accessibility: Leading icons and avatars are decorative (`aria-hidden="true"`); the title names the row.
Switches use `role="switch"` + `aria-checked` and are labelled by the row title.
Label inset groups with their `.overline` heading through `aria-labelledby`.
For ↗ rows that open a new tab, add visually hidden "(opens in a new tab)".
In the React audio row, give the play button an `aria-label` in your wrapper if you replace the default ▶.
content: Titles are short nouns: "Language", "Downloaded Bibles", "Daily verse", "dot.Bible directory".
Meta adds one fact: "7:00 each morning", "500+ languages", "Partner · Lima, Peru".
End values show the current setting ("Amharic", "3"), not instructions.
